Live Calligraphy & Engraving for Events

“Time is the most valuable thing a man can spend.” -Theophrastus
A considered detail can transform an event from memorable to unforgettable.

I offer live calligraphy and hand engraving services for high-profile brand, marketing, and hospitality events, creating personalised pieces for guests in real time. Working quietly and professionally within event settings, I add a layer of craftsmanship that feels rare, intentional, and deeply personal.

These services are particularly suited to luxury launches, private dinners, press events, and brand activations where attention to detail reflects the values of the brand itself.

Live Personalisation

Live personalisation allows guests to witness craftsmanship as it happens — an experience that feels both intimate and exclusive.

Popular applications include:

  • Hand engraving on glass, bottles, fragrance, candles and make-up
  • Live calligraphy on packaging, cards, tags, and keepsakes
  • Hot Foiling on leather, faux leather and silk
  • Personalised notes or dedications for guests or VIPs

Each piece is created by hand, ensuring that no two are ever the same. The result is an object that feels thoughtful, permanent, and meaningful — far beyond a standard branded gift.

Brand & PR Events

I regularly work with brands and agencies to support product launches, press previews, influencer events, and private client experiences.

Live craft offers a powerful alternative to mass personalisation, aligning particularly well with heritage, fragrance, fashion, beauty, and spirits brands. It provides a tactile moment within an otherwise fast-paced environment, encouraging guests to pause, engage, and connect with the brand story.

All work is tailored to the visual language, tone, and practical requirements of the event.
